title: Large Language Models To Improve the Quality of Care of Cardiology Patients
official: Towards Bridging Generalists to Subspecialists With Large Language Models
summary: This study evaluates the impact of large language models (LLMs) versus traditional decision support tools on clinical decision-making in cardiology. General cardiologists will be randomized to manage real patient cases from a cardiovascular genetic cardiomyopathy clinic, with or without AI assistance. Each case will be assessed by two cardiologists, and their responses will be graded by blinded subspecialty experts using a standardized evaluation rubric.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Board certified or board eligible Cardiologist.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not currently practicing clinically
